comparison_scope: Fast development baseline comparing rohccxx v0.4.1, pinned rohc-lib, and uncompressed/control; not a formal, marketing, absolute-performance, or cross-version benchmark

environment.hardware: recorded for diagnostic context; not fixed and not used for absolute claims

ipv4_id_policy: stable per flow: 0x1234 + flow; no cross-version or 16-bit wrap stress dimension
operation_order: balanced Latin rotation of steady compression, steady decompression, round-trip, and control treatments

validity_gates.correctness: all required checks pass before timing

runner_contention: load, swap, CPU steal, topology, and timing clock are recorded as diagnostic metadata for this development run

statistics.interval: fixed-seed nonparametric bootstrap 95% CI with 10000 resamples

final_authorization: --mode final --authorize-final; exact manifest, executable, source, libraries, flags, environment, and calibration-plan identities required
pre_post_validation: byte-exact reconstruction and canary guards before and after every workload
